text:
mira: Quick heads-up — proposing a staged pin of runtime 3.2.1 for llama-q family tonight in the 22:00-23:30 PT change window. Need SDK 1.8.0 cross-check before canary. :eyes:

sam: +1 from infra side if canary is limited to us-west-2 and we have auto-fallback configured. what's the exact canary shard?

mira: canary shard: rw-canary-5 (10% traffic). Plan: pin runtime on canary hosts only, run smoke suite, then expand to 50% in 1h if no regressions. Final rollout if metrics stable after 3h.

anya: Are we pinning model variants too or only runtime? I want to avoid model/runtime mismatches for quantized builds.

mira: Only runtime pin initially. We'll keep model pinned at existing variant. If we see kv-cache tousle, we may pin model->3.2-q as well.

deploy-bot: Scheduled action queued by @mira:
```
- action: pin_runtime
  runtime_version: 3.2.1
  target: rw-canary-5
  window_start: 2026-03-20T22:00:00-07:00
  window_end: 2026-03-20T23:30:00-07:00
  canary_traffic_pct: 10
```

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: runtime artifact checksum OK, runtime->sdk compatibility matrix requires SDK >= 1.8.0 OR shim 1.7.9+compat.

sam: I'll reserve the canary hosts and enable metrics retention to 1m granularity for the window. Also adding a temporary alert: token-latency > 2.5s for 2 consecutive mins => rollback.

lisa: QA: we have a focused smoke test set for llama-q longseq and kvcache. ETA to run once pinned: 12 minutes. I can monitor live traces.

anya: SDK team: do we have any runtime-breaking changes in 1.8.0? I remember a change in kv-cache serialization.

sam: SDK 1.8.0 includes a change that softens cache header validation. It's backwards compatible with runtime 3.1.x but runtime 3.2.1 tightens checks. We validated the shim path in staging but not at scale.

mira: Given that, two options:
- Option A: Require SDK >= 1.8.0 in deploy (enforce pin at service level)
- Option B: Proceed with runtime pin + safety-net: add fallback routing to `llama-q-lite` when `kvcache` validation fails, and enable SDK shim for older clients.

anya: Opinion: Option B is less disruptive to customers. But we need a clear rollout gating criteria and a kill-switch.

mira: Proposed gating criteria:
1) 0 blocked requests with kvcache errors in first 20 min OR fallback rate < 0.5%
2) p95 latency change < 10% compared to baseline
3) no new client errors > 1% of requests
If any fail, immediate rollback of runtime pin to 3.1.x on rw-canary-5.

deploy-bot: Added rollback command to the scheduled action. Rollback manual trigger: `deploy-bot rollback 3135792468` or auto if alert fires.

qa-bot: Smoke suite executed after pin (22:06 PT): 12 tests run, 12 passed. Longseq throughput within 6% of baseline.

lisa: Observability note: enabling extra traces for kv-cache decode on canary only. I'll watch errors and open traces.

sam: Region expansion plan: if canary stable 60m, expand to us-west-2 50% (rw-canary-5 + rw-canary-6), then eu-west-1 canary at 10% next day.

anya: SDK release note snippet to coordinate with support:
```
SDK 1.8.0
- kv-cache header validation softened to be compatible with runtime 3.2.1
- new env var RUNTIME_COMPAT=3_2 enables enhanced checks
- fallback behavior for invalid caches: client will rehydrate from prefix if possible
```

mira: Customer-facing release note (short): "Small runtime update to improve kv-cache validation and latency for long sequences. We will enable this in a canary window starting tonight; no action required unless you run a custom SDK older than 1.7.9 — please upgrade to 1.8.0 for best compatibility."

sam: I'm adding the SLA impact blurb to internal release docs: expected <0.1% error delta.

deploy-bot: Action executed: runtime pin applied to rw-canary-5 at 2026-03-20T22:02:31-07:00. Health check: ok.

qa-bot: Post-pin smoke: 0 kv-cache errors observed in first 10m. All longseq tests stable. :white_check_mark:

lisa: Live metric: p95 token latency +7% at minute 18, within gating. Fallback rate 0.03%.

mira: All green so far. Proceeding with staged expand to 50% after 60m unless anyone objects.

anya: No objections from SDK. I'll publish the compatibility note to #announcements after expansion completes.

sam: One note: if fallback rate creeps, we should temporarily drop canary to 2% and increase shim logging rather than full rollback. Keep rollback as last resort.

mira: Agreed. Adding an intermediate step in the runbook: throttled rollback -> reduce traffic -> enable extra shims -> rollback runtime if still failing.

deploy-bot: Scheduled expand action queued for 23:05 PT: increase canary to 50% on rw-canary-5/6. Auto-cancel if any alert fires.

mira: Thanks team. I'll update the release notes and hand off to support docs. If nothing pops up in the next 40m, consider this staged pin approved. :tada:

sam: ping me if the latency crosses 2.0s; I'll pre-emptively reduce traffic.

anya: Publishing note to #support and tagging @support on completion.

deploy-bot: Expand action completed at 2026-03-20T23:06:12-07:00. Canary traffic now 50%. Health checks green.

qa-bot: Post-expand checks: 48 tests, 48 passed. No kv-cache regressions. :white_check_mark:

mira: Final: rolling to full production will wait 12h for night-watch window. We'll reconvene if anything anomalous shows up. Closing thread for now.

sam: Good job all.

anya: Nice coordination.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by schedule: monitoring continues for 12h.
